description_en: Retrieves all samples of a custom entity. Pagination is supported
description_zh: 分页查询指定实体下的所有识别样本信息
kebab_example: aliyun ice list-recognition-samples --algorithm landmark --lib-id lib1,lib2,lib3 --entity-id 00000000000000544cb84754000000000000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --entity-name custom_person --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListRecognitionSamples

parameters.help_en:
The type of recognition algorithm. Valid values:

landmark

object

logo

face
parameters.help_zh:
识别类型，取值：

landmark：自定义地标。

object：自定义物体。

logo：自定义logo

face：自定义人脸

label：自定义标签
parameters.name: algorithm

parameters.help_en: The library ID. If you specify this parameter, the system performs an exact match. You can specify multiple library IDs. Separate them with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 库ID，传入则精确查该库；支持传入列表，用","分割
parameters.name: lib_id

parameters.help_en: The entity ID. If you set this parameter to ANY, the system queries by EntityName
parameters.name: entity_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size
